title.zh: 韩系推拉式数字锁基座（插芯锁体）

summary.en: The design language that dominated Asian smart locks for a decade: a tall push-pull handle set replacing an entire mortise lock set. It is a full-replacement architecture, so the retrofit problem is not adapters — it is the lock case matrix.
summary.zh: 主导亚洲智能锁十余年的设计语言：用高大的推拉把手组整体替换插芯锁组。它属于整体替换架构，所以改造难点不在适配件，而在锁体尺寸矩阵。

en: Tall push-pull handle units inside and outside
Mortise case with latch and one or two deadbolts
Battery compartment inside the inner unit
Often a separate remote or keypad
zh: 内外两侧的高大推拉把手单元
带斜舌与一到两个方舌的插芯锁体
常配独立遥控器或键盘

measurements.typical: 60 mm and 70 mm are the two that matter

how.en: Door edge to the case centre line.

measurements.typical: Case faceplate 24 mm wide, 240–300 mm long

how.en: Measure the strip on the door edge.

measurements.typical: Handle screw pitch 38–70 mm depending on set

how.en: Screw hole to screw hole on the handle.

notes.en: Because the handle is replaced wholesale, the interface that needs engineering is the lock case matrix and the strike alignment, not a clamp. Publish the exact envelope you replace and ship a cardboard template.
notes.zh: 由于把手是整体更换，需要工程化的是锁体尺寸矩阵与扣板对位，而不是夹具。请公布实际替换的孔位包络，并随货提供纸板模板。

en.q: Why are Asian smart locks rarely 'retrofit'?
en.a: Because the market standardised on replacing the whole lock set at installation time, so nobody needed a clamp-over adapter. Retrofit clamps are a European answer to a European lock.

en.q: What fails first on these sets?
en.a: The motor gearbox and the battery contacts, followed by the keypad membrane in humid climates.

zh.q: 为什么亚洲智能锁很少做“改造”？
zh.a: 因为市场在安装环节就标准化为整套换锁，没人需要夹持式适配件。夹持改造是欧洲锁催生的欧洲答案。
电机减速箱与电池触点，其次是潮湿气候下的键盘膜。
